requirements.text: Implement strong customer authentication methods, such as biometric authentication, in compliance with PSD2 requirements.
Ensure data handling practices align with GDPR to protect sensitive customer information while developing new features.
Provide real-time transaction updates to enhance customer experience while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
Develop budgeting tools and transaction categorization features that offer insights into spending habits, adhering to GDPR and Central Bank regulations on responsible lending.
Collaborate closely with legal and compliance teams throughout the development process to minimize regulatory risks and ensure adherence to all relevant standards.
Implement robust security measures for data storage and transmission.
Conduct a thorough impact assessment for any feature involving user data.
